preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_attempt WHERE ( summary_json IS NOT NULL AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json) = 'object' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_exists_all(summary_json, ARRAY[ 'selected', 'pending', 'succeeded', 'created', 'updated', 'skipped', 'failed', 'blocked' ]) AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'selected') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'pending') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'succeeded') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'created') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'updated') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'skipped') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'failed') = 'number' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(summary_json -> 'blocked') = 'number' ) IS NOT TRUE

SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_result WHERE ( ( merge_checkpoint_json IS NULL AND accepted_external_checksum IS NULL AND accepted_implementation_revision IS NULL AND accepted_implementation_checksum IS NULL AND mapped_model_spec_revision IS NULL AND mapped_model_spec_etag IS NULL ) OR ( merge_checkpoint_json IS NOT NULL AND ( pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json) = 'object' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_exists_all(merge_checkpoint_json, ARRAY[ 'tenantId', 'projectKey', 'dbtUniqueId', 'acceptedExternalChecksum', 'acceptedImplementationRevision', 'acceptedImplementationChecksum', 'mappedModelSpecRevision', 'mappedModelSpecEtag' ]) AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json -> 'tenantId') = 'string' AND pg_catalog.btrim(merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'tenantId') <> '' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json -> 'projectKey') = 'string' AND pg_catalog.btrim(merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'projectKey') <> '' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json -> 'dbtUniqueId') = 'string' AND pg_catalog.btrim(merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'dbtUniqueId') <> '' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json -> 'acceptedExternalChecksum') = 'string' AND (merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'acceptedExternalChecksum') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof( merge_checkpoint_json -> 'acceptedImplementationRevision' ) = 'number' AND (merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'acceptedImplementationRevision') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof( merge_checkpoint_json -> 'acceptedImplementationChecksum' ) = 'string' AND (merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'acceptedImplementationChecksum') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json -> 'mappedModelSpecRevision') = 'number' AND (merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'mappedModelSpecRevision') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(merge_checkpoint_json -> 'mappedModelSpecEtag') = 'string' AND (merge_checkpoint_json ->> 'mappedModelSpecEtag') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND project_key IS NOT NULL AND pg_catalog.btrim(project_key) <> '' AND accepted_external_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND accepted_implementation_revision > 0 AND accepted_implementation_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND mapped_model_spec_revision > 0 AND mapped_model_spec_etag ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND status IN ('CREATED', 'UPDATED', 'SKIPPED') ) ) ) IS NOT TRUE

SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_result WHERE pre_attempt_pins_json IS NOT NULL AND ( pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(pre_attempt_pins_json) = 'object' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_exists_all(pre_attempt_pins_json, ARRAY[ 'modelRevision', 'modelChecksum', 'implementationRevision', 'implementationChecksum' ]) AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(pre_attempt_pins_json -> 'modelRevision') = 'number' AND (pre_attempt_pins_json ->> 'modelRevision') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(pre_attempt_pins_json -> 'modelChecksum') = 'string' AND (pre_attempt_pins_json ->> 'modelChecksum') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof( pre_attempt_pins_json -> 'implementationRevision' ) = 'number' AND (pre_attempt_pins_json ->> 'implementationRevision') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' AND pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof( pre_attempt_pins_json -> 'implementationChecksum' ) = 'string' AND (pre_attempt_pins_json ->> 'implementationChecksum') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' ) IS NOT TRUE

SELECT count(*) FROM modeling_model_spec_import_apply_attempt WHERE CASE WHEN pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(selected_closure_json) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN true ELSE ( SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) <> pg_catalog.count(DISTINCT closure.member) FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(selected_closure_json) AS closure(member) ) END

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc function JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace namespace ON namespace.oid = function.pronamespace WHERE namespace.nspname = pg_catalog.current_schema() AND function.proname = 'modeling_jsonb_text_array_unique_v20260802'

changeSet.comment: Fail closed before DDL when canonical import JSON is incomplete or a selected closure contains duplicate members, then add forward-only constraints for future writes.
